WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON s.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    tradekind,
    avg_optvolrt,
    ABS(avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals)) AS deviation
  FROM pair_averages
),
with_type_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation
  FROM with_deviation
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    deviation - type_avg_deviation AS excess
  FROM with_type_average
  WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio,
  AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average
GROUP BY tradekind;
